description: This file declares the external API functions for the SLAP component related to the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP), including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions.

methods.name: SlapCreateComponent
methods.description: Creates a SLAP component instance with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapCoCreate
methods.description: Creates a SLAP component object with specified contexts.

methods.name: SlapCoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the objects associated with the SLAP component.
